headline: Damaged Goods
caption:
Paddy Pimblett just called Ilia Topuria "damaged goods" after his loss to Justin Gaethje.
Paddy or Topuria? 👇

The UFC lightweight star doubts Topuria will ever be the same fighter when he returns, and says Topuria is the only fight left for him. Their feud goes back to a 2022 hotel run-in at UFC London.

Who wins if they finally fight?
question: Paddy or Topuria?

v2.story: Pimblett says Topuria won't be the same after losing to Gaethje.
v2.question: Paddy or Topuria?
